sources.fact: Messages POST supports MessagingServiceSid, To, Body and StatusCallback. A returned SID is acceptance, not handset delivery.

Verify HMAC-SHA1 over the exact public URL plus all decoded POST fields sorted in case-sensitive key order, with the Account Auth Token; Base64 signature comparison uses Node timingSafeEqual. No SDK is needed.
Authenticated OptOutType is supplied with Advanced Opt-Out; STOP withdraws, HELP does not opt in. OM never automatically clears a withdrawal on START.
